description.text: The modification pack (改造包) came in the Happy Set Altaria & Latios & Infernape & Maushold of 12 September 2025. Its ten cards are for a player who lost a game to add to their deck before the next. It holds two of six Pokémon, three of six Supporters, three of six Items and two of five Pokémon Tools, never the same card twice. One of the Pokémon, Bombirdier ex, turns up 3.1% of the time; the other five Pokémon are made in equal numbers, and so are the cards within each of the other kinds. At the Happy Together 2 shop events the two losers of each round tossed a coin and took turns picking from it. Its 23 cards are numbered out of 23.
